Subject: Renewal coming up + possible expansion (follow-up)

Hi Rafael,

We’ll be up for renewal with Redwood in late July and there’s been internal momentum to expand our committed capacity for analytics features tied to Q4 product launches. Before we get into legal, procurement would like a clear commercial proposal: a price path for an increased commit, any one-time credits you can offer to help with the migration of 3 new teams, and whether Redwood can hold current pricing while we finalize internal approvals (target window: 60–90 days).

Can you put together an initial proposal we can review with procurement? If helpful, I can loop in Diego from procurement (cc’d). We’d like something tangible by next week.

Thanks,
Elena Parkel
Head of Product
Orion Analytics

--

Hi Rafael,

Thanks — procurement here. High-level numbers: we’re looking to increase committed capacity by roughly 40% (baseline = current committed GPU hours), onboarding two additional product teams (wave 1: Sep 1, wave 2: Nov 1).

Our asks are straightforward:
- Pricing hold for current unit price for 90 days while we complete approvals
- A one-time migration/onboarding credit (we typically see this as an invoice credit) to cover ramp costs (~$20k–$30k)
- A step discount for the incremental 40% commit (target ~8–12% off list for that delta)

If you can provide a signed term sheet or draft amendment that captures those points, we can move faster.

Diego

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Orion thread. They're proposing +40% commit across two waves and asking for: 90-day price hold, $20k–$30k onboarding credit, and an 8–12% step discount on the incremental commit.

Two asks:
1) Can we offer a 90-day price hold? I think we can if we attach a short letter of intent and require signature of the amendment within that window.
2) On the economics — suggested options:
   A) 10% discount on incremental 40% commit, $25k one-time credit, 12-month minimum extension for the new commit; OR
   B) 8% discount + $15k credit + one additional month of dedicated burst capacity during onboarding (value-managed)

I prefer A for simplicity but want to confirm legal/finance appetite and whether we should make the price-hold conditional on a short non-binding LOI. Also need approval authority on credits > $20k.

Can you reply with recommended wording and an approval path? I’ll need something customer-ready by next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Rafael

Rafael — good summary. Quick guidance from Commercial:

- 90-day price hold: OK if we require a signed amendment or LOI within 90 days. Draft language: "Redwood will honor the existing per-unit rates for a period of 90 days from the date of this Term Sheet provided Customer executes the attached Amendment or a Letter of Intent committing to the expanded tier within that period."

- Credit: approve up to $25,000 as a one-time invoice credit for onboarding/migration. Anything above requires VP approval.

- Discount: authorize a 10% discount on the incremental commit (apply only to the delta above current committed units) if customer agrees to a 12-month extendable commitment on the expanded tier.

- Conditions: pricing and credit contingent on no material data residency or security deviations; if Orion requests private deployment add-ons, we need to re-evaluate.

Ben — please flag if finance needs different amortization wording. Laura — please prepare the amendment template (SOW amendment + short-term LOI) and attach for Rafael to send.

Marissa

We should also include a clause that any unused committed units in the new tier true-up at the end of the 12 months (standard true-up).

Subject: Renewal amendment and commercial offer (formal)

Elena / Diego — thanks for the details and patience while we aligned internally. Attached are: a one-page Term Sheet (Redwood_Renewal_TermSheet_v2.pdf) and a short SOW amendment template (Orion_SOW-Amendment.docx). Highlights of the commercial offer: 

1) Price hold: Redwood will hold current per-unit rates for a period of 90 days from today (expires 2028-10-02) provided Orion signs the attached Amendment or a Letter of Intent within that window.

2) Incremental commit: For the requested +40% capacity, Redwood offers a 10% discount applied to the incremental units only. The incremental tier will be added to your subscription and is subject to a 12-month minimum term (extendable).

3) Onboarding credit: One-time invoice credit of $25,000 to be applied on the first invoice after the Amendment becomes effective. Credit will be recorded as contra-revenue per Redwood policy.

4) True-up and safeguards: Standard true-up at the end of the 12-month term for any shortfall; temporary burst capacity during the wave 1 onboarding will be provided (up to 200 GPU-hours) at no additional charge to smooth initial demand.

5) Conditions: Offer contingent on no material security or residency changes. If Orion requests a private deployment or VPC-only data flow, pricing will be re-evaluated.

Next steps:
- I’ve attached the term sheet and draft amendment. If this looks good, please sign the LOI or the Amendment before 2028-10-02 to lock the rates.
- If you prefer, we can open a 30-minute working session tomorrow to finalize redlines (I’m available 10–12 PT).

Doc links / attachments: Redwood_Renewal_TermSheet_v2.pdf (attached), Orion_SOW-Amendment.docx (attached). HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/987654/DEAL-ORION-2028

Thanks — looking forward to continuing to scale with Orion.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
